title: OpenPersonality
tagline: An open personality platform that mints traits NFTs for social activities such as finding friends, dating, job compatibility and self-awareness
description:
An open personality platform that mints traits NFTs for social activities such as finding friends, dating, job compatibility and self-awareness.

Personality tests have always been silo-ed, be it for self-understanding, input to dating apps for better batches, or used by HR in hiring decisions to find suitable candidates. An open personality protocol makes these data available for all to access and portable. It can be utilised by new forms of dating apps, social network apps, web3-enabled hiring platforms, and psychology research.

Imagine being able to do personality tests just once, and mint trait NFTs which you can use to find friends, jobs, dates, or simply have fun sharing and comparing with friends.
how_its_made: Built with ❤️ using Typescript, Next.js, hosted on Vercel! This is an open-sourced project built upon IPIP (https://ipip.ori.org/), a collaborative effort to refine personality inventories. I'm working towards building up all the contracts so people can mint personality traits to be used for various use cases on web3.
